parent_objective: run exact plus two-surface replay preflight over M1154 to M1346 interpolation alphas
blocked_by: M1351 designs the interpolation preflight but no alpha result exists

public_gates: M1352 must not use private holdout
M1352 must preserve actor input contract
M1352 must run exact objective metrics before replay
M1352 must run M267/M264 before any M183/M170 replay
forbidden_shortcuts: do not skip exact objective metrics
do not skip M267/M264 replay for exact-admitted alphas
do not run full public replay

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether a small-alpha region of the M1346 objective direction preserves first public replay proof surfaces
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: limited interpolation proof replay only; no promotion, private-holdout, PPO, full replay, paper-level, high-fidelity, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if no alpha is exact-admitted
stop if exact-admitted alphas fail M267/M264
stop if M183/M170 fails after M267/M264 passes
fallback_plan: if no exact alpha exists, route to objective redesign audit
if M267/M264 fails for all exact alphas, route to replay-aware active-set repair design
if M183/M170 fails, route to boundary-cliff repair design
if an alpha passes both, route to limited repeat or full public replay design
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1351 admits one interpolation preflight run

admission_evidence: M1351 design specifies sparse alpha ladder and replay ordering
M1349 raw M1346 replay failure suggests update amplitude/trust-region check
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: selected alpha or failure route is explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1352 checks public replay proof retention but cannot claim closed-loop anticipatory self-identification.
history_necessity_tests: M267/M264 and conditional M183/M170 replay compare normal versus wrong-history outcome retention
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: fixed source-history exact metrics plus public boundary-outcome replay surfaces.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If no alpha passes, record that the M1346 direction is unusable under replay retention before repair or redesign.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: A smaller interpolation of the M1346 objective direction may preserve exact source-history objective lift while avoiding M267/M264 proof washout.
success_criteria: alpha_summary.csv exists and includes exact metrics plus replay outcomes
all candidate checkpoints preserve actor input contract and allowed mutation scope
M267/M264 replay result is recorded for every exact-admitted nonzero alpha
M183/M170 replay result is recorded for every alpha that passes M267/M264
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, full replay, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: alpha summary is missing exact or replay columns
M267/M264 is skipped for an exact-admitted alpha
M183/M170 is skipped for an alpha passing M267/M264
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, full replay, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1352 may only advance if exact-admitted alphas pass M267/M264 and conditional M183/M170; otherwise route to the corresponding audit or repair design.
